verbatim_quote.original: sync telegram and create tasks all need github load skills and memories and follow
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Sync Telegram and create tasks; all of them need GitHub; load skills and memories and follow them.

extracted_decision.summary: Every Telegram-synced task gets a GitHub issue; skills and project memory must be loaded and followed during the sync.
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager wants full traceability (local task + issue) and no hallucination (skills + memory first).
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: More turns per sync in exchange for standards compliance.
